messages:
sara_ops: FYI — Pager <> Slack integration acting weird. Seeing repeated page-resends for the same incident. PD shows incident muted for the rotation but Slack keeps re-posting and re-paging oncall. Anyone else seeing duplicates?
incidentbot: [system] Alert delivered to #incidents and triggered page to @mike_oncall at 12:03 UTC. Resend scheduled due to no ack.
mike_oncall: I got 3 pages in ~2 mins. Couldn't see the original slack thread until the 3rd one. Slack thread UI was collapsed and the webhook reaction showed :x:. Super noisy.
jordan_sre: digging into pagerflow logs — seeing repeated PD retries (429s) to our webhook from 12:02-12:05. Also noticed a "mute_state" mismatch between PD payload and our cache. Example payload: `{"incident_id":"I-123","muted":true}` but cache read returned false.
sara_ops: That matches redis dumps I pulled: mute_state=true for the incident, but our handler read false because TTL renewal raced with the write.
nina_support: Any customer impact yet? Which customers were routed to external buddy oncall?
ryan_oncall2: Support ticket #6789 shows partner SRE reported delayed alert — they received nothing until 12:15. We manually escalated at 12:16 per contract. So ~12 minute delay for that partner.
jordan_sre: Mitigation in progress: disabling the "resend-on-unacked" logic for incidentbot and clearing the mute-state cache keys for affected incidents. Applying change now.
devops-bot: deploy started: revert-resend-logic v2 -> will finish in ~30s (CI green).
incidentbot: [system] Resend logic disabled, cache keys cleared for 18 incidents. Observed no further resends after 12:19.
mike_oncall: Confirmed — no more duplicate pages. Sent manual page to external partner at 12:18, they acknowledged.
sara_ops: Preliminary root cause: race between PD webhook retries and local cache TTL renewal. That caused duplicate-detection to fail and triggered resends. Also an edge-case where PD marked incident muted after retries completed.
jordan_sre: Action items: 1) add idempotency check on PD webhook payload (assign @jordan_sre), 2) make cache writes atomic / use conditional set (assign @devops-bot), 3) add monitor metric for mute-state-desync (assign @sara_ops), 4) run full postmortem and customer impact summary (assign @nina_support).
nina_support: I'll update impacted customer tickets with the 12-minute alerting delay and link to the internal incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3123456789
sara_ops: Thanks. Leaving this incident open for a full RCA. Assigning to @jordan_sre for the postmortem, due EOD.
